description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for managing challenge data, including saving and updating user challenge progress, and defines challenge-related constants for a coding education platform.

methods.name: saveUserChallengeData
methods.description: Saves or updates a user's challenge data in an array, updating last saved date and challenge files.

methods.name: updateUserChallengeData
methods.description: Updates a user's challenge progress in the database, handling challenge completion, saving challenge state, and removing from partial challenges.
